text:
Maya: Quick ask — planning a condensed design review for the new API/SDK/Console UX flow (billing quotas + auth). Wanted to lock a 45m slot next week and share a pre-read/checklist. TL;DR: needs review for surface-level UX and API contract, + canary rollback plan. Pre-read: https://redwood/doc/pre-read/api-sdk-console (draft). Can you drop availability and any must-have agenda items?

Tony: I can do Tue/Wed mornings PST. 45m works. Add a quick 'back-compat' check.

Sam: Can we make it 60m? There's a lot to demo. Otherwise we might run over. Also add 'metrics/telemetry' review.

Leah: I'll own pre-read edits by EOD Fri. Will add code samples and a short migration FAQ.

Raul: FYI, need to include Dedicated/private deployment implications. Also confirm who will own rollout / rollback.

Maya: noted. Agenda draft in thread: 1) 5m goals + acceptance 2) 10m API contract + breaking changes 3) 10m SDK ergonomics 4) 10m Console UX walkthrough 5) 5-10m Rollout/telemetry/fallback plan. Please add items. I'll post final pack by Fri 3pm PST.

Tony: +1. If folks want longer demos we can do a follow-up deep-dive. Also pinging @design-bot to publish a Loom link.

Sam: Can someone run a quick poll? My votes: Tue 10am PST, Wed 11am PST. Prefer Tue.

Leah: Tue 10 is fine.

Maya: Quick poll: https://polls.redwood.com/3t9 — choose preferred slot. I'll finalize when poll hits 60% yes. Also checklist snippet — please confirm these before review:
```
- Pre-read posted and read
- Key open questions listed
- Demo env stable + sample requests
- Canary rollback doc attached
- Contacts for infra/qa on call
```

Raul: I'll add the canary section. Also ping @infra-team for on-call.

design-bot: Calendar draft created for Tue 10:00 PST (45m) — tentative. Invite: https://calendar.redwood/event/abcd

Tony: :thumbsup: Looks good. I'll slot 20 mins of live demo.

Sam: Thanks all. One more ask — include sample tracing snapshot for s3 auth latency edge case.

Maya: Will include. Closing asks: please update poll or DM me by Thu EOD if you need a different time.
